purpose: Teach: カマ/ぽん/はいっ/よれ/たがら/辰/くろ/うぅ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんちのカマ、立派だったわね
lines.en: Sho, Grandma's kiln was really something special, wasn't it.
lines.style: Warm, nostalgic exhale. Soft focus — she's remembering the visit, not addressing him directly. Gentle rhythm, like a thought shared aloud rather than a statement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが、ぼくの肩、ぽんと叩いてくれたよ
lines.en: Dad gave me a tap on the shoulder, Mom.
lines.style: Bright, almost breathless — excitement bubbling just beneath. Quick syllables on the action. Watching her face to see if she understands how good it felt.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがはいって来たわよ
lines.style: Light, informational — she's not lecturing, just letting him know. Turned-toward-him, but gentle. The tone of a mother noticing something and passing it along.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくの体操服、よれちゃったよ
lines.en: Mom, I messed up my gym clothes.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact with an undertone of regret. Not quite apologetic — more like he's reporting an inevitability. Small voice, accepting his own bad luck.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お薬を食べたがらないのは困るわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm having a time with you not wanting your medicine.
lines.style: Patient but tired underneath. Not scolding — genuinely a little stuck. Warm exhale, like she's admitting she doesn't know how to solve this one. Slight slope downward at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、辰年生まれだよね
lines.en: Mom, I was born in the Year of the Dragon, right?
lines.style: Curious, reaching upward slightly. Asking for confirmation, not showing off. Genuine wondering — he wants to know if she remembers. Small, hopeful pause at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ママのくろい着物、お祖母ちゃんに頂いたのよ
lines.en: Sho, this black kimono my mother gave me — I got it from Grandma.
lines.style: Nostalgic and tender. Gentle fingertips on the memory. Quiet pride in the object and its history. Speaking as if he might understand someday why this matters.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、うぅ、ぼく、お風呂はやだ
lines.en: Mom… ugh, I don't want to take a bath.
lines.style: Small, tired whine with genuine dread underneath. The 'uu' carries exhaustion and reluctance. Trailing off like he's given up the argument before starting it. Slumped posture in the voice.
